classes.lymphocytes: Dense sheets of small, round, uniformly dark lymphocyte nuclei with scant cytoplasm, closely packed and evenly distributed, forming the diffuse lymphoid tissue and follicles of a lymph node on H&E staining.
classes.adipose_tissue: Perinodal fat composed of large, empty, polygonal clear spaces separated by thin pink cell membranes, with flattened peripheral nuclei and few other cells.
classes.artifact_background: Non-diagnostic area: blank white or pale background at the tissue edge, or tissue distorted by artifacts such as darker folded double-thickness tissue, crushed or cauterized smeared dark nuclei, out-of-focus blur, air bubbles, ink, or pen marks.
classes.Normal: Normal breast tissue at 20× magnification, showing orderly ducts and lobules composed of regularly arranged epithelial structures with open lumina, embedded within fibrous and adipose stroma. The tissue exhibits organized glandular architecture, relatively uniform epithelial cellularity, and well-defined epithelial–stromal boundaries without dense irregular epithelial proliferation or destructive infiltration.
classes.Tumor: Breast tumor epithelial tissue at 20× magnification, showing densely cellular malignant epithelial proliferation arranged in irregular glands, nests, cords, or solid sheets, with disrupted architecture, variable gland formation, and infiltrative growth within fibrous or desmoplastic stroma.
